parole.significato: divan, sofa, couch (upholstered furniture with open cushions or a back (soft) for sitting and lying down)
parole.testo: From French divan, from Ottoman Turkish دیوان (divan), from Classical Persian دیوان (dēwān), Middle Persian d(p)ywʾn' (dēwān, “archive, collected writings”), from Sumerian 𒁾 (dub).
